item.title: Medicine Shortages Worsen in Southern Shan State Following Import Ban
item.description: Southern Shan State is facing a growing medicine shortage after nearly five months of import restrictions disrupted supply chains and pushed prices sharply higher, residents and healthcare workers say. Since mid-August 2025, the military-ordered Foreign Exchange Supervisory Committee has restricted imports of foreign food, consumer goods, and medicines through border crossings and maritime routes.
